n5f10909ebc.headline: State Statistics Service: wage arrears in Ukraine increased by 42.5%
n5f10909ebc.summary: Ukraine's wage arrears increased by 561 million hryvnias (42.5%) in 2015, with the industrial sector, transport, and scientific fields most affected.
n5f10909ebc.why: Rising wage arrears indicate economic stress and labor market challenges, affecting consumer spending and business operations in Ukraine.
